chunks: And if I were to be lost to you, and the distressing events would befall you,
and the gripping calamities, many of the askers would remain silent, and many of the replied-to would lose courage,
and that would be when your war has contracted, and rolled up its sleeve, and the world has become narrow for you with constriction,
you would prolong the days of tribulation upon you, until Allah would grant victory to the remaining virtuous among you.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the period after Imam Ali's death according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) foretells a period of political turmoil and intellectual stagnation following his death, where the 'Kharijites' and Umayyads would cause widespread confusion, leading to a scarcity of knowledgeable scholars capable of addressing the people's needs. This era of hardship and narrowed worldly prospects serves as a divine test, culminating in the eventual triumph of the 'Baqiyat Allah' (Remnant of God), a key Shia concept referring to the Imam or the righteous scholars who preserve true guidance amidst chaos.
